description: This file defines a PHP class 'DecodingEventStreamIterator' that implements an iterator to decode, validate, and iterate over a binary encoded AWS event stream. It handles parsing stream headers, prelude, events, and CRC checksum validation.

classes.name: DecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class to decode and read individual events from a binary AWS event stream, ensuring validation through checksums and parsing headers, payloads, and prelude.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a given stream and prepares for decoding.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses header entries from the header bytes, extracting key-value pairs.

methods.name: parsePrelude
methods.description: Parses the message prelude, verifies its checksum.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Decodes a single event from the stream, including headers, payload, and checksum validation.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current event.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current event's position index.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next event, parsing it from the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream and initializes the first event.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is still within stream bounds.

methods.name: readAndHashBytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from stream and updates the CRC hash.

methods.name: decodeBooleanTrue
methods.description: Decodes a boolean true value.

methods.name: decodeBooleanFalse
methods.description: Decodes a boolean false value.

methods.name: uintToInt
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to a signed integer based on size.

methods.name: decodeInt8
methods.description: Decodes an 8-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint8
methods.description: Decodes an 8-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: decodeInt16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: decodeInt32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: decodeInt64
methods.description: Decodes a 64-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint64
methods.description: Decodes a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: unpackInt64
methods.description: Unpacks 8-byte data into a 64-bit integer considering PHP version differences.

methods.name: decodeBytes
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length byte array.

methods.name: decodeString
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length string.

methods.name: decodeTimestamp
methods.description: Decodes a timestamp value from the stream.

methods.name: decodeUuid
methods.description: Decodes a UUID value from the stream.
